title: Record a reversal for an approved payment
description: Finance needs to record that a previously APPROVED payment was reversed (e.g. chargeback or manual correction). This introduces a new status, REVERSED, for payments that were approved and then reversed. This request only asks for the change to be specified (scope, transition rules, acceptance criteria, edge cases); implementation is out of scope for this ticket.
notes: REVERSED should only be reachable from APPROVED. Whether DECLINED or PENDING payments can also be reversed is an open question for the spec, not a decision already made.
